newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end up on Telefonica buying.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end up on Telefonica buying.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed up Thursday lifted by foreign investors buying benchmark Telefonica del Peru, brokers said.
They said prices would likely rise slightly again Friday.

Thursday, the General Index IGRA climbed 0.45 percent to 1,545.6 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index ISEL rose 0.53 percent to 2,228.9 points. In 1,185 trades, volume was 31.9 million soles ($12.2 million), brokers said.
Investors sought Telefonica, which closed up 0.52 percent at 5.84 soles in heavy volume of 3.5 million shares, because falls earlier in the week made its price attractive, they said.
"At the beginning of the session, the market rose, pushed up by Telefonica -- because of its recent corrections -- and fell off a little toward the end," Julio Alcalde of local brokerage MJS said.

Among other leaders, tin miner Minsur rose 0.97 percent to 9.40 soles in volume of 203,000 shares. The country's largest brewery Backus y Jonhston climbed 0.90 percent to 2.25 soles in strong volume of 3.2 million shares.
